title: St. Tyna's Chapterhouse
description: Upper floor of a building visited during [Echoes of Silenced Bells](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935921)

title: Secret Shrine
description: Underground, in the ruins visited as part of [In the Name of the Father](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953823); reached via [Father Florin's Hideout](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953970#L). Cannot be used as a fast travel point.

title: Western Slopes
description: Restored via the Western Slopes Shrine's Heart, found at a nearby [Bandit Camp](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=936574#L).

title: Small Bridge
description: Its heart is held by one of the soldiers attacking it.

title: Ocha's Hideout
description: Appears here after [The Heart Wants What It Wants](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941670)

title: Sanzhana Merchant
description: Only appears after completing [Pearly and Precious](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942103). Sells the Silk Threads needed for [A Bulwark Against Darkness](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=939000). Moves to the [Yawning Burrow](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941729) after some time has passed.

title: Hermit
description: Acts as an unmarked blacksmith after progressing [A Bulwark Against Darkness](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=939000) or [Forge It Anew](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941717)

title: Medic
description: Found during the day near a hut south of the swamp.

title: Vicho
description: Unlocked as a vendor after completing [A Study in Crimson](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940834)

title: Ursul
description: Appears after freeing prisoners as part of [Ambrus's Prisoners: Lucky Crossing](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938183)

title: Catalin's Tutor
description: Appears here if he is released during [Bakir's Pillories: Old Hand](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940652)

title: Constantin
description: Must be spared when attacking the [Bandit Camp](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940895).

title: Ocha
description: Appears here after [The Heart Wants What It Wants](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941670)

title: Drogos
description: Only acts as a teacher after completing some Manumit quests.

title: Butcher
description: Spoken to as part of [The Heart Wants What It Wants](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941670)

title: Fishmonger
description: Sell fish to the Fishmonger to unlock the Selfish trophy / achievement.

title: Withering Away
description: [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935865) Tips: - Use hot water, and three spoonfuls of herbs. - Head through the village to pick up a bunch of side quests - but note that you won't have the time to complete all of them. - Quests that do not progress time: - [If a Tree Falls in a Forest...](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935850#L) - [Enter Not](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935847#L) - [Dead Drop](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935868#L)

title: Bad Blood
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935865) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935918) Tips: - Approach Vlad's house to begin [The Firebrand](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935920) and progress the rebels' questline.

title: The Firebrand
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935879) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938631) Tips: - Search the fireplace for two letters. - When visiting [Stoneward Post](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938623), tell the guard you're there to enlist - and say 'What? A soldier without a weapon?' to get in peacefully - but still armed. - Bring 300 Denarius to bribe the warden - or be ready to do his dirty work. - Once you reach Mert, free him within 4 days or he will be executed.

title: Echoes of Silenced Bells
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935918) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938996) Tips: - Monastery keys can be found in a building at the north-western end of the courtyard - The body in the chapel responds to a nearby prayerbook and rosary. - Read the Campana Loquitur, found inside a locked building, to unlock the ability to direct the nuns into a building of your choosing via the bell.

title: Shadows in the Woods
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935920) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938642) Tips: - Have 100 coins spare for a bribe. - Following Sara to the camp at night will skip you forwards to daytime.

title: The Gilded Gauntlet
description: Appears when Ambrus' anger reaches its highest level. Tips: - Invest in some abilities - they can't be blocked! - You don't have to fight with a sword. - During his unblockable wild swings attack, use Shadowstep to teleport behind him.

title: A Friend Like This
description: [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938982) How to Start: Read the Note for Ambrus, found on his corpse, or a note in Bakir's treasure room. Tips: - During the interrogation, mention your family for a peaceful resolution. Reward: - XP

title: Home Sweet Home
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942119) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942120) Tips: - Invest in Swordmastery and Witchcraft abilities - your gear will be limited. Reward: - XP - Skill Point - [Astrologer's Ring](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938923) - Life Lock (Witchcraft perk - only if [What Moves the Dead](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942118) was completed)

title: Song of the Mountain
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938667) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938986) Tips: - Follow the wind chimes to stay on the right path - Say that 'nobody needs to die!', then stay passive, to avoid bloodshed

title: Hive and Seek
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938982) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941728) Tips: - Be ready to fight a _lot_ of Kobolds. - They can totally be trusted :) - Be sure to grab [Isbrand's Plate](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941726)

title: A Monk and a Saint
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938996) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941717) Tips: - Pick up a piece of charcoal, and the writings on the wall should go as follows: - Abelard the Sorrowful - Svartrau plaza - ...his penance, the place of his redemption - ... never once set foot inside it - St Mihai, a great warrior, arrived at Vale Sangora... - Saint Mihai's grave is the second one from the right end of the row. - The blacksmith you need can be found [here](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935942). Rewards: - XP - Skill Point - Broken Sword of St. Mihai

title: Where Old Devils Lie
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938996) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941874) Tips: - To solve Enolf's riddle, examine the shrine to the east of the map, then the water. Reward: - [Runic Enchantment](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941873)

title: The Lunar Game
description: _Begins when Bakir's anger reaches its highest level._ Tips: - If participating in the tournament, return to Farkas in the afternoon to avoid skipping time. - Examine a bush in the courtyard for poisonous leaves; you can use them to poison the Cockroach's liquor and skip his fight in the maze. - Tell Porcupine that you'll leave him alone to skip a fight in the maze - Tell Marten that her brevity is a nice change of pace after Farkas; she'll give you an amulet in the maze. - Loot chests in the maze for better gear - Remember that you can't use any vampiric abilities (or even your claws!) - Swordmastery abilities are OK, however. - The odd riddle's solution is the left hole. - Invest in some abilities - they can't be blocked! - After killing the Boyar, only leave through the southern door if you want a miniboss fight.

title: A Lone Wolf's Hunt
description: Previous | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940721) Tips: - A back door can be used by clearing [Racovitza's Bandit Camp](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938961) or completing [A Hero's End](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953824) - To escape Xanthe's trap, look for triangular banners. - If you left any Boyars alive, be ready to face them and their forces. - You're coming for the king. Best not miss. - If you'd rather bargain, complete [Hive and Seek](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938986) or [Where Loyalty Lies](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938642)

title: Things Will Be Different Now
description: _Epilogue_ Tips: - Only the furthest snare has caught anything.

title: A Deal with the Devil
description: _Begins once you reach Infamy level 9. May also require the death of the three Boyars._

title: The Heart Wants What It Wants
description: How to Start: Speak to Bakr-Ocha as part of [A Mother's Plea](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938985) and agree to help. Tips: - To learn more about Andrei, speak to Katja, a woman sitting by the city walls. - Tell her that you're helping Nora. - Ask about her problem, then give 400 Denarius for more information. - After that, you'll need to find something silver to get to Andrei. - Once he leaves, take the ring. - You can then pay Katja 50 Denarius to distract the guard. Reward: - XP - Denarius x150 - [Broad Swing Manual](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941688) - [Ocha](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942109) as a Swordmastery Teacher

title: Forge It Anew
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=939001) Tips: - Sword shards can be found in these locations: - [Forge It Anew: Do Not Disturb](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938151#L) - [Forge It Anew: Hostile Takeover](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938153#L) - [Forge It Anew: Executive Order](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938152#L) Reward: - XP - Skill Point - [Imbued Sword of St. Mihai](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941718)

title: Our Rotten Roots
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938986) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942140) Tips: - Upgrade your Shadowstep abilities for an easier time traversing the area. - Be ready for lots of back-to-back combat; bring healing items and upgrade your Vampiric abilities. Reward: - XP - Skill Point - Piercing Shriek (Vampirism perk)

title: Stronger Than Achilles
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=939002) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935879) (Rebels) / [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938667) (Lacra) Reward: - Font of Life perk (if you drink the blood) - Grants passive Regeneration of Human Health. - XP - Skill Point

title: What Moves the Dead
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940788) | [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942119) Tips: - If your Infamy is high enough, you can scare away the outlaw. - Speak to an old woman sitting on a bench to learn where the cobbler's shop is. - Have 50 Denarius to spare for a bribe.

title: The Cycle of Love
description: Begins when Xanthe's anger reaches its highest level. Tips: - Invest in some abilities - they can't be blocked!

title: In the Name of the Father
description: How to Start: Enter the church during the daytime, and confess your sins. [Next](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953824) Reward: - XP - Skill Point

title: A Hero's End
description: [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953823) Tips: - Be ready to fight a lot of undead, and a Spectre boss. - If it's daytime, don't drop into the cave under the ruins - you won't be able to get back out. - Examine the murals you find to begin [The Champion of Old](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953964) - A door in the ruins can be opened via key found in the same building as a [Phial of Xanthe's Blood](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953969) Reward: - XP - [Ancient Hero's Armor](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953965)

title: Live Bait
description: How to Start: Speak to your siblings during [Withering Away](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935828), and agree to join them. Tips: - If playing tag, press the talk button when you reach the kids to stop them. Reward: - XP

title: Deep Down
description: How to Start: Speak to Gavril, and agree to look for his brother. Tips: - Loot the boss for his weapon Reward: - XP - Denarius x50

title: On the Run
description: How to Start: Speak to Iorgu, and agree to look for his pig. Tips: - For 100 Denarius, you can buy the pig instead of slaughtering it. The pig will remain at your house even after the prologue and will provide another quest. Reward: - Denarius x50 + 250 XP + 4 Sausages (if you kill the pig) - Denarius x50 + 250 XP (if you spare the pig)

title: Blasphemy
description: How to Start: Speak to Gremla, and agree to look for her banner. Tips: - Search the area beside the shed for footprints, a cane-hole, and a scrap of the banner. - Speak to Premysl at the eastern edge of the village, slightly south from Coen's house. Reward: - XP - Denarius x25

title: Someone Needs a Lesson
description: How to Start: Approach Vasil Tips: - Press the talk button when you reach Vasil to stop him in his tracks. Reward: - XP

title: Disturbed
description: How to Start: Speak to Crina and offer to help find Kvet's pendant. Tips: - When the trail goes cold, look for a shovel head near the shed. Reward: - XP - Denarius x25 (if the cross is returned)

title: Enter Not
description: How to Start: Approach the house Tips: - Climb the debris beside the house, then crouch to get inside. Reward: - XP

title: If a Tree Falls in a Forest...
description: How to Start: Approach the corpse beneath the tree. Reward: - XP

title: Like Father, Like Son
description: How to Start: Complete [Withering Away](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935828) with some time left before night-time. Reward: - XP - [Charge Manual](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935867)

title: Dead Drop
description: How to Start: Inspect a grave. Tips: - Look for symbols carved into trees. Reward: - XP

title: Page-Turner
description: How to Start: When visiting Anca as part of [Withering Away](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935828), stick around to read Latin with her. Tips: - Be sure to grab ALL of the herbs hanging in the shed. Reward: - XP

title: A Pilgrimage for Power: Bear Trouble
description: How to Start: Approach the windchime. Tips: - Be ready to fight a bear! Reward: - [Ravenous Flock Manual](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935939)

title: Pilgrimage for Power
description: How to Start: Complete any Pilgrimage for Power quest. Tips: - Other Pilgrimage for Power quests: - [A Pilgrimage for Power: Bear Trouble](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935938#L) - [A Pilgrimage for Power: Dark-Thing](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938703#L) - [A Pilgrimage for Power: Fanatics](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938948#L) - [A Pilgrimage for Power: The Ritual](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940628#L) Reward: - N/A

title: The Cursed Chasm
description: How to Start: Approach the bridge. Tips: - Be ready to fight an Echo! Reward: - [Durandal](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938257) - XP - Skill Point

title: Ambrus's Prisoner Transports
description: How to Start: Approach any of the prisoner transports. Note that they move around, so may not be in this exact spot. Reward: - N/A

title: Ambrus's Dungeons
description: How to Start: Approach the outpost. Reward: - N/A

title: Forge It Anew: Do Not Disturb
description: How to Start: Approach the area. Tips: - The trail leads to a Kobold-infested cave. - Examine the paintings to begin [Forge It Anew: Executive Order](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938152#L) and [Forge It Anew: Hostile Takeover](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938153#L) Reward: - XP - Sword Shard

title: Forge It Anew: Executive Order
description: How to Start: Approach the area, or examine the painting in another cave. Tips: - The sword shard can be found in [this camp.](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941641#L) Reward: - XP - Sword Shard

title: Forge It Anew: Hostile Takeover
description: How to Start: Approach the area, or examine the painting in another cave. Tips: - Be ready for a boss fight! Reward: - XP - Sword Shard

title: Wisp Treasure Hunt: East Road
description: How to Start: Approach the [Will-o-the-Wisps](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938170#L) Tips: - Be ready to fight a pair of bandits on the journey. Reward: - XP - [Manual](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938172)

title: Buried Past
description: How to Start: Speak to the [Grocery](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938175), confirm that you're Pieter's son, and ask if he's sure the beer was for your father. Tips: - Purchase the beer for 200 Denarius - The wolves can be found [here](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938191#L) - Volk's knife can only be found at night; it's sticking out of his roof. Reward: - XP - Skill Point - Volk's Sword

title: Lost Blood
description: How to Start: Approach the cargo. Tips: - Be ready to fight a Murohn - The merchant can be found [here](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938979#L) Reward: - XP - [Medicus II Manual](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940800)

title: Finders Keepers
description: How to Start: Loot the Map: Silver Cache from a sack in the chasm. Reward: - [Finders Keepers Treasure](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938258#L) - XP - Skill Point

title: Bakir's Headhunters: Secret Stash
description: How to Start: Compel the soul of a rebel in the same area as [Bakir's Headhunters: Silent to the Grave](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938573). You'll need to use the Interrogation Instrument to learn about the treasure. Reward: - [Secret Stash Treasure](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938575)

title: Under Watchful Eyes
description: How to Start: Release Mert from his cell. Tips: - Be ready to fight a LOT of soldiers - if you haven't already. Reward: - XP

title: Star-Crossed Lovers
description: How to Start: Speak to the armourer and offer your help, or find a body in the nearby woods. Reward: - XP - Skill Point - Denarius x100 - Recipe for Minor Vitality Balm

title: A Pilgrimage for Power: Dark-Thing
description: How to Start: Approach the area. Tips: - Be ready to fight an Echo Reward: - XP - [Ravenous Flock Manual](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938704)

title: Good Home
description: How to Start: Approach the glowing rock. Reward: - XP - Skill Point - A message [sent to Lunka](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941730)

title: The Hedgehog Herb
description: How to Start: Approach the destroyed house. Tips: - The body must be compelled with an axe and watering can. Reward: - XP - Skill Point - Razkovniche Elixir - when consumed: - +20% Maximum Human Health - +10% Maximum Vampiric Health - +1 Skill Point

title: A Pilgrimage for Power: Fanatics
description: How to Start: Approach the wind chime. Reward: - XP - [Ravenous Flock Manual](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938949)

title: A Bulwark Against Darkness
description: How to Start: Receive and read a Secretive Letter; Anca should give it to you after [Echoes of Silenced Bells](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935921), or it can be obtained in Svartrau's market. Tips: - The blacksmith you need can be found [here](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=935942). - The flask of quicksilver is inside [Aurelius's Tower](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938924) - The relic of a saint can be found on a corpse inside a locked building at [St. Tyna's Convent](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938638) - The moult of a large lizard can be found in an [unmarked cave.](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942142) - The bundle of silk threads can be purchased from a [Sanzhana Merchant](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942104), or found in the cave visited during [Come Hither](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942105) Reward: - XP - [Arbiter Armor Set](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942143)

title: Don't Kill the Messenger
description: How to Start: Approach the blood-stained part of the road. Reward: - XP - Skill Point

title: A Pilgrimage for Power: The Ritual
description: How to Start: Approach the wind chimes (approach from the west). Tips: - Be ready for a miniboss fight against a witch Reward: - XP - [Ravenous Flock Manual](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940630)

title: The Price of Magic
description: How to Start: Enter the stone circle. Tips: - Be ready to fight an Echo miniboss Reward: - XP - Mysterious Bracelet

title: Old Friends, New Friends

title: Ambrus's Cuirass
description: Looted from the body of Ambrus.

title: Astrologer's Ring
description: Looted from the Astrologer after completing [Home Sweet Home](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938922)

title: Pieter's Garb
description: Inside a chest beneath the campfire; can only be dug up after learning about it during [Buried Past](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938176)

title: Ancient Footwear
description: Underground, inside a chest in the same room as the miniboss fought during [Xanthe's Excavations: Bloodied Dagger](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940593). To loot it, you'll need to find the ritual dagger in the same room and compel the assistant's corpse with it.

title: Recipe for Potent Keen Eye Potion
description: Inside a chest in the gatehouse.

title: Wolven Bracers
description: Inside a chest at the back of a cave visited during [Of Wolves and Men](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940845)

title: Vrakhiric Bracers
description: Inside a chest within the treasury, visited during [The Lunar Game](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940653)

title: Ring of Quick Strikes
description: Inside a chest within a locked room of the ruins visited as part of [The Highland Grave](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941607)

title: Arbiter's Medallion
description: Looted from a skeleton in the loot-filled cave behind the waterfall.

title: Phial of Bakir's Blood
description: Looted from the Bloodletter miniboss encountered after destroying the last of Ambrus's collector camps. Unlocks Shadowstorm in the Vampirism skill tree.

title: Ancient Hero's Vambraces
description: Looted from the corpse of an Uriashi soldier found in the [Xanthe's Transports: When Two Dogs...](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938204) area.

title: The Purge
description: Looted from the Houndmaster miniboss that appears here as a [Headhunter](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940634)

title: The Shredder
description: Looted from the witch miniboss that appears here as a [Headhunter](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941611)

title: Ring of Focus
description: Looted from an Uriashi miniboss that appears here as a [Headhunter](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941630)

title: Imbued Sword of St. Mihai
description: Reward for completing the ritual as part of [Forge It Anew](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941717)

title: Phial of Bakir's Blood
description: Looted from the reliquary if you choose not to destroy it as part of [Xanthe's Recruiters: Come Home](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=941720) Unlocks Shadowstorm in the Vampirism skill tree.

title: Isbrand's Plate
description: Inside a chest in the room where you find Isbrand as part of [Hive and Seek](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938986)

title: Runic Enchantment
description: Obtained as part of [Where Old Devils Lie](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=939002)

title: Phial of Brencis's Blood
description: Looted from the reliquary if you choose not to destroy it as part of [Xanthe's Recruiters: Taste of Power](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942107) Unlocks Piercing Shriek in the Vampirism skill tree.

title: Vicho's Cross
description: Reward for completing the second half of [A Study in Crimson](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=940834), available after checking out the farm during [The Good Samaritan](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942122). Depending on how you resolve the quest, it'll be obtained automatically or must be picked up from beside his bed.

title: Arbiter Armor Set
description: Reward for completing [A Bulwark Against Darkness](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=939000) Pieces: - Chestpiece: _Enhanced Armour of the Arbiter_ - Trousers: _Enhanced Shin Guards of the Arbiter_ - Bracers: _Enhanced Bracers of the Arbiter_ - Boots: _Enhanced Boots of the Arbiter_

title: Gladius
description: After defeating the miniboss as part of [The Beast of Balaur](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=942882), Shadowstep up to a hidden area within the cave.

title: Phial of Brencis's Blood
description: Looted from the hidden room within the cave. Unlocks Piercing Shriek in the Vampirism skill tree.

title: Erkas's Sword
description: Looted as part of [The Champion of Old](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953964)

title: Ancient Hero's Armor
description: Inside a coffin reached after defeating a boss as part of [A Hero's End](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953824)

title: Phial of Xanthe's Blood
description: Inside a box on the upper floor of the treasury. To get inside, visit the church during the daytime and speak to the Acolyte child in the corner - he'll get you into a room that holds a key for the building. You can also get inside freely at night. Drink it to obtain Blood Surge in the Vampirism tree.

title: The Hand of Fate
description: Inside a chest within a cave beneath the ruins, visited as part of [A Hero's End](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953824). Visit at night or you'll be stuck in the cave. To unlock it, you'll need a stone key found in the same building as a [Phial of Xanthe's Blood](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953969).

title: Boyaress Xanthe
description: Appears here at night, regardless of anger level.

title: Hole in the Wall
description: A convenient way in and out of the city without using the gates.

title: Large Lizard's Moult
description: At the back of an unmarked cave; the entrance is here, approximately 164 metres south of the [Witchcraft Vendor](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=938239). Quest item for [A Bulwark Against Darkness](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=939000). Note that four Tatzelwurms guard the moult - be ready for a fight against the game's most annoying enemy type!

title: Further Twists and Turns
description: The prisoners from [Ambrus's Dungeons: Twists and Turns](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=936586) are here attacking merchants if you told them to oppose Brencis' rule.

title: Father Florin's Hideout
description: Visited as part of [In the Name of the Father](https://mapgenie.io/the-blood-of-dawnwalker/maps/vale-sangora?locationIds=953823)

title: Like a Bat out of Hell
description: Beyond the fort, you'll find a way out of the valley - and can use it to leave the madness behind for good, leading to an early ending and unlocking an achievement.
